body: EXPLICIT OPERATOR RULING, received in the supervising session: Approve this scope and proof. The approved question was: proceed with the concrete #155 fix, a guard preventing automatic resume of needs-human tasks (#158), and regression/scenario proof that explicitly leaves a NEW post-fix live limit/resume Not proved. Gates and fresh review remain required. This is the actual operator answer and supersedes the earlier misattributed automatic continue; preserve that provenance correction in the evidence. Implement the #158 hard-stop guard with regression coverage, complete the approved #155 fix and owning docs, rerun all required gates and fresh review of the final head, then continue the authorized hands-off PR/CI/merge workflow. The narrowed proof basis is approved; do not claim a NEW post-fix natural limit or automatic recovery occurred. Task state remains yours to restore. Preserve task pins, models and host caps.
